text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!! A new Oka Sho 
champion is born!!!”
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "WOOOOOOOO!! Ikuno, you were amazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! That was so cool~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Man, seriously... She's totally 
blinding..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
......I have witnessed it with my own 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I, too, must do what I have to—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I gave it... my best! However, the 
exhaustion is just as immense—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (So this is... a Classic race...?!)
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(—Cheers and raw excitement envelop the 
venue.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(And that ignited a fire... in both my 
heart and body—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Bring it back. That tension and 
exhilaration I felt just moments ago, 
sharpening my skills against first-rate 
Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(This burning sensation that lingers, as 
if I'm still running the race...—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ah... Truly—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —It was a magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(It's overflowing... The lingering 
resonance is taking shape――)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"To have run in this Oka Sho... I'm so 
glad..."

—Upon Ikuno Dictus's return, traces of 
exhaustion from the fierce battle were 
evident on her face.

On the other hand, a sense of quiet 
fulfillment can also be seen in her 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Having run it myself, I've truly come 
to realize it. The sheer magnificence of 
the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even I, who possessed only the most 
mundane of aspirations, am moved this 
deeply. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If it were an Umamusume with a deep 
attachment to each race, it surely would 
have fired up their heart and soul even 
more intensely.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"So much so... that I wouldn't hesitate 
for a second to put everything on the line 
to run."

I'm certain Ikuno Dictus and I are 
picturing the exact same Umamusume right 
now.

The Umamusume of the past who pushed 
beyond their limits in races and seized 
the glory of victory—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—And one more thing: I gained the 
unwavering conviction that "I can become 
even stronger."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"In this Oka Sho, I found deeper and more 
profound lessons during the race than ever 
before..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If she tears through the Tiara route with 
this momentum... I can hardly contain my 
excitement.
choice_data_list:
Then we'll have to make sure to take good 
care of it afterwards!

Then we'll have to make sure to take good 
care of it afterwards!

text_block_list.text:
...And so, Ikuno Dictus ran brilliantly in 
the Oka Sho, the first race of the Triple 
Tiara—
—A few days later.

Having recovered from the fatigue of the 
Oka Sho, Ikuno Dictus and I sat down for a 
meeting to discuss her future plans—
choice_data_list:
I think we should run the Flora Stakes 
next.

text_block_list.text:
The "Flora Stakes" is a 2000m 
medium-distance GⅡ turf race held at Tokyo 
Racecourse.

It's also a race that Umamusume running 
the Tiara route often run as a trial race 
to gauge their chances in the Oaks.

Ikuno Dictus and I had originally 
considered entering this race before the 
Oaks. The reason being—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—It is to reassess my aptitude for medium 
distances, and to find a clue to victory, 
correct?

I nod in agreement. Our biggest immediate 
goal, the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), is 
a 2,400m turf medium-distance race at 
Tokyo Racecourse, and—

The distance is a full 800 meters longer 
than the Japanese Oaks. The toll it takes 
on the body to run it all the way through 
will undoubtedly be greater than that of 
the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Therefore, I shall ascertain beforehand 
at the "Flora Stakes" whether she can go 
the distance in middle races...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Having run the Oka Sho myself, I felt 
the exact same need."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"We'll need to carefully verify our own 
aptitudes, I reckon."
choice_data_list:
...Depending on the results, the Oaks 
might...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I understand. That withdrawing from the 
race is a valid option. However—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I will deliver results without fail. So 
that I may stand in the Oaks."

And so, the Flora Stakes was engraved into 
"IRON WILL" as Ikuno Dictus's next goal 
race.
And as a little more time passed—

Nakayama Racecourse. The day of the 
Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Ines Fujin is breaking away, pulling 
ahead! But she's been caught 
shoulder-to-shoulder!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
I'm passing them, I'm passing them! —And 
across the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! Both Ines Fujin and Mejiro Ryan 
were so close~~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The third favorite won, huh... What an 
incredible race at the finish line...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I couldn't reach it...! I was so 
close...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ………… ...Ines is—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...This isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Still... heheh...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I get it... I've finally realized...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Next time... in the Japanese Derby...! I 
will definitely, 'surpass' them...!!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Is this... trembling...? Watching 
Ines-san, my body is...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(This sensation, I'm sure I've felt it 
before——)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Surpassing your limits, betting 
everything on a single moment, laying 
everything bare—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run in an amazing way like 
that!!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. The feeling when I heard those 
words—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Back then, I felt a certain intensity... 
and a sense of precariousness from 
Ines-san...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I truly hope this is just a baseless 
fear...)

"With the first crown of the Classic races 
concluded, each contender begins to move 
forward toward the second—"
